summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing routine time charter contracts for two dry bulk vessels: the m/v New York (Capesize) at $27,500/day gross, minus 5% commission, from ~May 1, 2026 to min Feb 1, 2028/max Mar 31, 2028; and the m/v DSI Pyxis (Ultramax) at $16,000/day gross, minus 5% commission, from ~May 3, 2026 to min Jun 15, 2027/max Aug 15, 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, or special structural terms. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
